## Firestore Read Spike (>50,000 reads in 5m)

Cloud Firestore document reads exceeded 50,000 in 5 minutes.

### Immediate Triage
1. Check whether public collections (`tickets`, `partners`, `previousSpeakers`, `team`) are experiencing scraping or listener fanout after a document edit.
2. Check whether `functionsRateLimits` reads are surging alongside a Cloud Run / Gen1 request spike.
3. Verify `sendGeneralNotification` / `scheduleNotifications` legacy functions are not scanning full collections.
